text:
sanjay: Quick q — we have a weak spot where a project-level API key can be used to route requests through a different org's quota when requests pass through our proxy. Seen it in traces. Need to decide: tighten routing by key->org binding, or emit richer telemetry and do soft-blocking first.

emma: can you paste the trace? is this repro or one-off? :thinking:

sanjay: repro on two customers. snippet:
```
X-Org: org-1234
X-Project: proj-777
Authorization: Bearer sk_live:proj-777:xxx
Host: proxy.internal
```
headers show org header mismatch after routing.

kasia: oh — this is our reuse rule where we allow project tokens to assume org context if upstream header present. we added it for some legacy clients.

ryan: iirc that was to support tenant-less clients during onboarding. but that's obviously risky for quotas and attribution.

sanjay: risk: quota pumping w/ different orgs, billing attribution wrong, and alerting noise. suggestion: start by emitting a new telemetry field `auth.bind_source` with values [issued, upstream-header, proxy-assumed] and rollout via a feature flag.

emma: agree. telemetry first. then block for proxy-assumed after 2 weeks with canary to 10% of traffic. need dashboard: per-org rate of proxy-assumed tokens + error spikes.

kasia: console UX: add a warning on project key settings: "This key can be used only within its project unless 'allow-legacy-proxy' enabled." default off.

ryan: security note: rotation — project keys should get a `bound_org` claim in the token to enforce at auth-time. requires token minting changes.

sec-bot: [automated] flagged 2 incidents in last 24h matching pattern `proxy-assumed` — details in #incidents thread 2245540001.

sanjay: plan summary: 1) add telemetry field + dashboard tile 2) rollout flag to emit telemetry in prod 3) canary block policy at 10% then 100% 4) token mint change to include bound_org claim 5) console UX change + docs. anyone object?

emma: no objections. can we add an audit log entry when we downgrade a request due to mismatch?

kasia: yes, will add audit event `auth.mismatch_action` with short reason codes.

ryan: putting a PR up for telemetry and a mock dashboard. tagging @kasia for console copy.

sanjay: thanks — i'll draft the rollout playbook and ping infra for canary routing rules. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flag `auth.telemetry.emit` -> rollout env=prod, 10% -> 2024-11-12T15:00:00Z
